versions.content: BswM shall postpone mode arbitration requests received dur- ing the processing of an IMMEDIATE request until it is finished. Any such postponed IMMEDIATE requests shall be processed directly after the processing of the original IMMEDIATE request. Any such postponed DEFERRED requests shall be processed in the next subsequent BswM main function.
